why: Set to fire on two remembered episodes, Palantir on 2026-06-25 (a fall of two fifths from its 120-day high, a fifth under its 50-day average) and Meta on 2026-03-27 (a fall of three tenths, a sixth under), and to be rare: in two years of daily closes those readings occurred in one cluster per name. The low side is for a long thesis, the high side its mirror for a short. A count of measures at or beyond these, never a blend, and changing any of them is a dated declaration.
notes: On the high side the dd_120 key holds the above_120_low threshold: close over the 120-day low, minus one.
RSI is Wilder's smoothed 14-day; on split-adjusted closes Palantir read 27 on 2026-06-25 and Meta 22 on 2026-03-27, so Palantir fires three of four on the low side and Meta four.
